segments.text: Allow your gaze to rest softly on each word as it arrives. There is nothing to do here but receive. Each word settles into you like a slow, warm breath.
And with every word you take in, you sink a little further. Down, and down, and gently down. Heavier now. Calmer now. Carried.
Stillness is easy for you. Your mind grows quiet and clear, like water with no wind. You hold this calm long after the words are gone.
In a moment you will lift gently back, bringing the calm with you, awake, clear, and rested.
And now, with the next slow breath, let your eyes drift softly closed, and simply keep drifting.
